description: React component for managing and displaying a list of users with referral statistics, including delete functionality and flexible schema handling.

methods.name: getReferralStats
methods.description: Extracts referral statistics from a user row, handling both object and array formats.

methods.name: fmtDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a locale string, returns '—' if invalid.

methods.name: fmtText
methods.description: Converts a value to string safely, returns '—' for null, undefined, or objects that can't be stringified.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches user data from API and processes it for display.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Sets the user row to be deleted, triggering confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDeleteAction
methods.description: Performs user deletion via API and reloads data.
